explanations.1: The viewBox attribute defines the coordinate system for drawing (0 0 64 64 means a 64x64 square), and role/aria-label make this SVG accessible to screen readers by describing what it represents.
explanations.2: rx and ry create rounded corners on the rectangle—rx is horizontal rounding and ry is vertical rounding, both set to 8 pixels here.
explanations.3: text-anchor='middle' centers the text horizontally at x=32, and dominant-baseline='middle' centers it vertically at y=40.
